items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I think Alec Wilder was the conductor.

ctx.x: Well, some of those things that I did -- I did so many with Vic Dickenson, I'd just not name them. And Mildred Bailey. I did so many recordings with her, I'm just going back then. I'm not talking about now, I'm going back to those days. And here's some that I did with Mildred Bailey. I think Alec Wilder was the conductor. You know.
